name: OGC API - Processes (Standard as Building Blocks)
abstract:
OGC API — Processes, authored as Building Blocks. This is a proof-of-concept demonstrating the
"OGC Standards as BBs" methodology, where the standards document is generated from a set of
Building Blocks rather than from AsciiDoc source. Covers Part 1: Core and Part 2: Deploy,
Replace, Undeploy (the latter still a DRAFT standard, not yet adopted).
description:
This repository contains the Building Blocks for OGC API — Processes Part 1: Core (OGC 18-062r3)
and OGC API — Processes Part 2: Deploy, Replace, Undeploy (OGC 20-044, **DRAFT**, not yet
adopted). It demonstrates the [OGC Standards as BBs](https://github.com/opengeospatial/ogcapi-processes/blob/master/docs/ogc-standards-as-bblocks.md)
proposal, where normative requirements, conformance tests, schemas, and prose are all co-located
in a Building Block, and the standards document is generated from the BB set.

New BB types introduced: `requirements-class`, `clause`, `terms`, `references`.
New `bblock.json` fields: `clause-index`, `normative`, `standardization-target`.

standards.title: OGC API - Processes - Part 1: Core
standards.abstract:
The OGC API — Processes Standard specifies a Web API that enables the execution of computing
processes, the retrieval of metadata describing their purpose and functionality and the retrieval
of the results of the process execution. The requirements specified in the OGC API — Processes
Standard build on the OGC Web Processing Service (WPS) 2.0 Standard and specify a processing
interface to communicate over a RESTful protocol using JSON encodings.

bblocks.name: Core
bblocks.abstract: Core requirements class for OGC API — Processes Part 1. Specifies the fundamental operations a server must support: landing page, conformance declaration, process list, process description, process execution, job status, and job results.

testResources.method: Issue an HTTP GET request to the path `/processes`. Validate that the response has HTTP status code 200 and that the response body is a valid JSON document conforming to the processList schema (ogc.api.processes.v1.schemas.processList).
Validate that a processList response body without the required `links` property fails conformance with the processList schema. The validator SHALL report an error.

bblocks.name: JSON
bblocks.abstract: Requirements class for JSON encoding. Requires that all supported API endpoints respond with application/json when requested.

testResources.method: Issue an HTTP GET request to each of the following paths: `/`, `/conformance`, `/processes`, `/processes/{processID}`, `/jobs/{jobID}`. Validate that each response includes `Content-Type: application/json` (or a subtype thereof) when the request carries `Accept: application/json`.

bblocks.name: Deploy, Replace, Undeploy
bblocks.abstract: Core requirements class for OGC API — Processes Part 2 (DRAFT). Specifies the fundamental operations a server must support to dynamically deploy, replace, undeploy processes, and retrieve the last application package used to deploy or replace a process: POST /processes, PUT /processes/{processID}, DELETE /processes/{processID}, and GET /processes/{processID}/package.

sources.title: OGC API - Processes - Part 2: Deploy, Replace, Undeploy

testResources.method: Issue an HTTP POST request to the path `/processes` with a formal process description in the request body. Validate that the response has HTTP status code 201 with a `Location` header, and that the response body is a valid JSON document conforming to the processSummary schema (ogc.api.processes.v1.schemas.processSummary).
Validate that a deploy-response body without the required `id` property fails conformance with the processSummary schema. The validator SHALL report an error.

bblocks.name: OGC Application Package
bblocks.abstract: Conformance class for OGC API — Processes Part 2 (DRAFT). Defines the schema of an OGC Application Package document — a formal process description used to dynamically deploy or replace a process — and the media type (application/ogcapppkg+json) used to carry it in requests and responses.

bblocks.name: CWL
bblocks.abstract: Conformance class for OGC API — Processes Part 2 (DRAFT). Enables support for the Common Workflow Language (CWL) as a process description encoding, either embedded in an OGC Application Package or sent directly as the deploy/replace request body.

testResources.method: Validate that a link object with `href` and `type: application/cwl` conforms to the `link` schema (ogc.api.processes.v1.schemas.link), as required when specifying a CWL execution unit by reference.
